notes.title: BIG release
notes.content:
Keep getting revenge. We've made so many changes, I can't possibly list them here.

We updated every area of the game, from the map, to the combat, to card management, balance, bugs, and so on.

We've added new aesthetics and added Spanish support!

I hope you like were we're heading.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Turn-based festival release!
notes.content: This is a release for players to view the game we're working on!
